connector.name: Biolit
connector.registryDescription: LLM-assisted biomedical literature screening and extraction for PubMed, GEO, and preprints.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package biolit. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rachadele account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key (required when using the default Anthropic provider)

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key (required when using LLM_PROVIDER=openai)

env.name: LLM_PROVIDER
env.description: LLM provider: anthropic (default), openai, or ollama

env.name: SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY
env.description: Semantic Scholar API key for higher rate limits on citation lookup (optional)

env.name: UNPAYWALL_EMAIL
env.description: Email address for Unpaywall API access to improve PDF retrieval (optional)
